mrIntro: Messages from people outside your contacts stay here until you accept. Names and IDs are unverified; compare fingerprints before trusting someone.
mrPolicy: Stored on this device across reloads for up to 7 days: 20 senders, 20 envelopes each, 100 total, 2 MiB total (128 KiB per envelope). Excess messages and unsolicited calls are dropped. Nothing is decrypted or previewed before acceptance.
mrFull: Достигна граница на съхранението; по-новите съобщения се свалиха
mrFailed: Не може да се актуализира поискванията за съобщение. Моля, по- пробвайте.
lnSimilar: “{0}” resembles existing contact “{1}” ({2}). Compare fingerprints before trusting this name.
lnUnsafe: “{0}” contains hidden/control characters or a risky mixture of scripts. Compare fingerprints before trusting this name.
daLinked: Досега невидимо свързано устройство (проверена корена подпис)
daSession: Друга инсталация, използвана тази идентитет (проверена подпис)
daPush: Another installation announced a push subscription (signature verified)
daRelayKeys: Relay reports different or missing account keys — unverified discrepancy
daUnavailable: Account activity checking is unavailable or incomplete. The relay may be withholding activity. This is not proof of a new device.
daLimit: Only signed, observed activity can be verified. The relay can withhold records. Session and push reports require upgraded, cooperating clients.
daRecovery: Unlinking revokes certified device keys on capable peers after the signed checkpoint arrives; legacy peers only stop fan-out. A copied identity or push subscription cannot be remotely revoked here: recover onto a fresh identity, notify contacts and stop using the compromised identity.
opScope: Exchange these identity invites BOTH ways in person. They expire in 30 minutes. Compare the fingerprint on both devices and confirm only if it matches. Keep this app open until /rendezvous finishes; reloading cancels pending pairing. No alias lookup or relay verification.
opMatches: Сравних и двете устройства: съвпадат отпечатъците
opCompare: Compare this fingerprint on both devices. It binds both encryption keys, signing keys and invite nonces.
opConfirmed: Contact verified. Open their chat and exchange /rendezvous codes. Messaging unlocks after encrypted key confirmation.
opInvalid: Offline pairing failed: invalid, expired, used or mismatched code/key, or unsupported cryptography. Cancel pending pairing and exchange fresh invites.
opPending: Finish offline pairing with /rendezvous before sending. Use /offlinepair cancel to cancel.
opCancelled: Pending offline pairing cancelled. Exchange fresh invites on both devices to retry.
rvScope: Requires an existing encrypted session or confirmed /offlinepair invitation. Exchange connection codes privately by QR or copy/paste; they expire in 10 minutes.
rvQRTooLarge: Този код е твърде голям за един QR. Използвайте копия/паст вместо това.
rvScanUnavailable: Camera QR scanning is unavailable in this browser. Use copy/paste instead.
rvInput: Код за връзка с връзката на дружество
rvWorking: Събиране или проверка на информация за връзка...
rvReady: Code ready / applied. Copy it to your peer, or paste their reply.
rvCopyFallback: Копирането не е достъпно. Изберете и копирате кода ръчно.
rvTrust: Connect once through a relay and verify this contact, or complete /offlinepair first. A pinned signing key and a session or confirmed pending pairing are required.
rvInvalid: Невалиден код за връзка или грешна стъпка за обмен.
rvExpired: Този код за връзка е изтече. Създайте нов.
rvReplay: Този код за връзка вече е използван.
rvTimeout: Прекратихме времето на събирането на ICE.
rvCandidates: No usable ICE candidates under your privacy settings. Check your network / TURN settings and redo the exchange.
rvRedo: Manual connection needs recovery. Redo /rendezvous with your peer.
heroDesc: No phone number. No email. No app store. Open a link, start chatting. Everything encrypted end-to-end.
inviteTitleAnon: You have been invited to Breeze
inviteDesc: Enter your name and start — you will be connected with your inviter automatically. No server setup and no registration needed.
featEncryptSub: Никой друг не може да прочете съобщенията си.
noCreditCard: Няма кредитна карта, няма имейл, няма подписване.
emptyContacts: Use the Add friend button to add a contact.
addContact:
Add contact:

Paste a Breeze link, @alias, public key, or invite message.
Type "group:Name" to create a group.
callSasLabel: Call verification code — read it to each other; it must match on both screens
gcallGenGate: Group calls from a linked device need everyone in the call on the latest app version
helpSetSaveDisplayName: Saves the display name in the field and shares your updated profile with contacts whose app supports profiles. The name helps people recognize you; it is not a unique identifier.
stickersEmpty: Все още няма приобретителни опаковки. Добавете снимки или вносете файл за опаковки.
stickersTooBig: Това изображение е твърде подробно за да бъде налепник.
stickersPeerNoCap: Този контакт все още не може да получава налепки
stickersGroupNoCap: Някои членове още не могат да получават налепки.
stickersBadPack: Този файл не е валидна опаковка за налепки
locUnavailable: Не може да получите местоположението ви
locPeerNoCap: Приложенията на този контакт още не подкрепя споделянето на местоположението
locGroupNoCap: Location sharing needs every group member on a supporting version
groupLegacyNoFs: ⚠️ Forward secrecy is off for this group: a member is on an older version without group v5. Ask them to update to enable it.
serverNotConfigured: Server not configured: KV binding required. Follow README setup. P2P and message relay unavailable.
serverNoDefault: Няма конфигуриран сървър. Добавете своето реле в Настройки → Домашни релета или първо хоствайте Breeze сами. Докоснете този банер, за да отворите Настройките.
gateServerDesc: Breeze has no official server. Add your own server to start. An invite link alone is not enough — you still need a server of your own.
noIdentity: Създаване на идентитет в пратеника първо
safetyDesc: Compare this number with your contact in person or via video call. If they match, your connection is secure.
snV2: Номер на сигурност v2 · 60 цифри · идентификационен
snLegacy: Legacy safety number · 96 bits. Compare only the same version; this display does not change verification.
snUseLegacy: Сравни номер на наследство вместо това
snVersion: Different display versions. Both choose the legacy number and compare again. This is not evidence of a key change.
snMismatch: QR comparison did not match. Check the contact and both keys before verifying.
ktOk: ✅ Automatically verified against the server key-transparency log
ktRolled: ⚠️ This contact's key changed since your last check — verify the safety number above carefully
ktTampered: 🚨 The server's key log looks tampered — do not trust this safety number
ktBlockLabel: Block new sessions when the key-transparency log looks tampered
helpSetKtBlock: Blocks a new encrypted session if the key-transparency history looks altered or its saved chain no longer matches. This is safer than only warning, but it can stop you from messaging until the key change is verified or the setting is turned off.
ktUnavailable: Key-transparency check unavailable (offline or no server)
deposited: Deposited at the relay — not yet received by them. Undelivered mail is kept for at most 7 days
backupCreatedUntil: Backup complete! Remember your passphrase. The relay keeps it until {0} — re-upload before then.
backupRelayDisabled: This relay does not store backups. Save a backup file instead, or use a relay you run.
toastRecoveryNoneBackup: This identity is disposable (no recovery), so backups cannot be created.
backupPassMin: Паролата трябва да бъде поне 6 знаци.
offlineBanner: Оffline — P2P чати все още работят
noSwitchCall: Не може да променя сметки по време на обаждане
helpSetBackup: Creates an encrypted backup on your relay when backup storage is available. The relay stores only ciphertext, but forgetting the passphrase means the backup cannot be restored.
helpSetRestore: Finds this account's encrypted backup on your home relays and restores it after you enter the required passphrase. Restoring replaces data on this device, so use it carefully.
helpSetAutoBackup: Automatically saves an encrypted backup after your data changes. It only runs after you enter the backup passphrase on this device, and only if your relay offers backup storage.
autoBackupNoServer: Your relay does not store backups, so automatic backup cannot run
autoBackupNeedPass: Enter your backup passphrase once on this device to start automatic backup
autoBackupPending: Има промени, които чакат да бъдат подкрепени.
autoBackupError: Последното автоматично резервиране не е успело
helpSetAutobackupArm: Lets you enter the backup passphrase once so automatic backups can run during this session. The passphrase is kept only in memory, so you may need to enter it again after reloading the app.
autoRestoreFoundDesc: A backup of this account was found on your relay. Restore it now? The data on this device will be replaced by the backup.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Opens step-by-step guidance for moving this account to another device using your recovery phrase or recovery account and passphrase. Your identity is not copied until you complete the restore steps on the new device.
migrateGuideDesc: 1. On this device, keep a backup on your relay (automatic backup above, or Create Backup). 2. On the new device, choose a restore option on the first screen and enter your recovery phrase — or your account name and passphrase. 3. When your identity is back, a backup on your relay is found automatically and offered for restore. No cables or files are needed.
backupNote: E2E encrypted. A relay only ever stores ciphertext — and only if its operator enabled backup storage. Remember your passphrase.
helpSetHideRr: Stops sending read receipts when you open a one-to-one chat. Senders will not see when you read their messages; the messages themselves still arrive normally.
helpSetHideTyping: Stops sending the typing indicator while you write. Your contacts will not see when you are composing a reply, but you can still see theirs if they share it.
relayOnly: Режим само за релай (скрийте IP от връзките)
helpSetRelayOnly: Routes peer-to-peer traffic through relay servers instead of direct connections, hiding your IP address from contacts. It can make calls and file transfers slower or fail when no usable relay is available, and the relay operator can still see connection metadata.
helpSetNotifSound: Plays a short sound when a message or call that is allowed to alert you arrives. Visual notifications are separate, and Focus mode or muted chats can still silence alerts.
helpSetSendSound: Plays a short sound when you send a message. It is only a local confirmation and does not mean the other person has received or read it.
noteEmpty: Няма бележка. Използвайте /note <text> за да добавите едно.
helpSetTabOrder: Changes the order of the bottom tabs. Drag a row, or use the arrow buttons; the tab bar updates immediately. Chats can be reordered but is always shown.
helpSetTabVisCalls: Shows or hides the Calls tab in the bottom tab bar. Hiding it does not delete call history or disable calling.
helpSetTabVisContacts: Shows or hides the Contacts tab in the bottom tab bar. Hiding it does not delete your contacts or chats.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Shows or hides the Profile tab in the bottom tab bar. Your profile remains available, and this does not change whether it is shared.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Shows or hides the Settings tab in the bottom tab bar. If you hide it while using Settings, Breeze returns to Chats; Settings remains available from the settings button or commands.
callHistoryLogLabel: Запазете историята на обаждания на това устройство.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Keeps a local list of outgoing, incoming, and missed calls on this device. Turn it off to stop new call records here; it does not delete history already saved.
dropRevealed: ✅ Тайната е разкрита — тази връзка сега е унищожена.
dropReadExpired: 🚫 Тази тайна вече е била прочетена или изтечена.
dropReadFailed: ❌ Неуспех на дешифроване. Връзката може да е невалидна или унищожена.
consentText: Breeze stores encrypted messages and settings locally on your device. No data is sent to third parties.
noIDBDesc: IndexedDB is not available. This can happen in private/incognito browsing mode. Breeze requires storage to save your keys and messages securely.
noIDBHint: Моля, използвайте нормален прозорец на браузъра.
noCryptoDesc: WebCrypto API is not available. Breeze requires HTTPS and a modern browser for end-to-end encryption.
noCryptoHint: Моля, достъп до Breeze над HTTPS (не HTTP).
wipeDesc: Permanently delete all messages, contacts, keys, and settings.
autoLockLabel: Автоматично заключване при превключване на таблички
helpSetAutoLock: If an app-lock password is set, locks Breeze when you switch away from its tab. You will need that password when you return; this does not replace locking the device itself.
labelNoneHint: Още няма етикети. Кликнете на десното кликване на контакт или използвате /label
labelNoneContacts: Още няма етикети. Дясно кликнете на контакт, за да добавите един.
labelNoneCmd: Няма етикети. Използвайте /label Работа, Семейство за добавяне.
helpSetNotifPerm: Asks the browser or operating system for permission to show notifications. Breeze cannot grant this itself; if permission was denied before, you may need to change it in browser or system settings.
lockPassPrompt: Настройване на парола за заключване (мин 4 знаци):
keyWrapPassPrompt: Настройване на фраза за замяна на ключове (мини 8 знаци):
keyWrapUnlockPrompt: Въведете парола за заключване на ключовете:
keyWrapAlreadyOff: В момента не е включено превръщане на ключовете
keyWrapWrongPass: Неправилна фраза - ключове не се зареждат
keyWrapChangeFailed: Key wrapping change failed — stored keys were not changed. Check the passphrase and storage, then retry.
keyWrapMin: Парола трябва да бъде поне 8 знаци
addContactPh: Публичен ключ@ alias, or invit link
backupNudgeBody: Архивът е единственият начин да се върнете в този акаунт, ако загубите това устройство. Отнема само миг.
nicknameLocalNote: Nicknames are stored only on this device. They are never sent to the contact or the relay.
showPeerNameLabel: Покажете също името на всеки контакт за себе си
helpSetShowPeerName: Shows the name a contact chose for themselves alongside the nickname you gave them. This only changes what you see locally; nothing extra is sent to the contact or relay.
connP2PDesc: Криптирана директна връзка — няма сървър включен
connRelayDesc: Сървър реле — съобщения за шифровани край- към- край
connOffline: Peer appears offline. Messages will be delivered via relay when they come back.
installBannerIOSTip: Натиснете Споделяйте след това Добавете към домашния екран
gpAnchorConfirm: Confirm {0} ({1}) as this group’s administrator? Only this pinned signing key will be allowed to authorize reduced author protection.
gpDowngradeTitle: Намаляване на защитата на авторите на групата?
gpDowngradeWarning: These members do not advertise signed-author support: {0}. Allowing them means any member with the shared group key can impersonate another author. Existing members will receive a persistent notice. Cancel keeps strict protection and does not admit this change.
gpUnanchored: No authenticated administrator. Strict protection cannot be reduced until you verify and confirm an admin contact.
gpDropped: ⚠ Author protection reduced by the pinned administrator. Legacy messages do not verify the individual author.
gpRestored: ✓ Signed-author protection restored. Unsigned messages are rejected.
gpSetAdmin: Потвърждаване на потвърден контакт с администратор
gpChooseAdmin: Изберете контактния номер на проверка на администратора:
gpVerifyFirst: Verify this contact’s safety number first, then confirm them as admin from this group.
gpFailed: Group security update failed. Unapproved changes remain blocked.
gpSelfConfirm: This device’s local record says you created this group. Confirm your locally authenticated signing identity as administrator? Encryption identity: {0}. Signing key: {1}. Other members must independently verify and confirm you.
cvReverify: Сравни номера на безопасността и проверете отново
cvCompare: Compare this number on both devices. It includes both encryption and signing keys:
cvMissingPin: A pinned signing key is required. Exchange an authenticated message first.
cvStrict: Изпращане на блока след ключова промяна, докато не се провери
cvFailed: Verification failed or keys changed during comparison. Reopen and compare again.
cvBlocked: Sending blocked: a contact’s keys changed. Compare safety numbers and re-verify, or turn off strict mode in /verify.
vaultNew: New vault passphrase (at least 12 characters; not your /lock password)
vaultLegacy: Екстен / keywrap парола, или остави празен ако няма
vaultScope: Protect keys, messages/files, contacts, drafts and private browser settings for all accounts? Save your recovery phrase and a vault file backup first. Theme, language and consent stay public. /vault lock locks every tab; /vault password changes the passphrase.
vaultDisable: Disable the vault for every account? Authentication is required. History, files, contacts, keys, drafts and private browser settings will return to vault-off storage.
vaultFailed: Vault operation failed. Check the passphrase and storage; no plaintext fallback is allowed.
vaultRecovery: This is not the /lock password. If forgotten, recover your identity using your recovery phrase on a fresh install. Existing vault sessions cannot be recovered without this passphrase.
vaultOldTabs: Close older Breeze tabs before changing the vault.
vaultBackupOnly: While the vault is enabled, exports contain only encrypted vault snapshots. Attachment downloads, cloud, automatic and recovery-kit exports are disabled.
dropDesc: One-time link. Self-destructs after reading. Key stays in URL fragment (never sent to server).
dropExpires: Изтече след 24 часа, ако не е прочетено.
keyChanged: ⚠️ Security key changed for {0}. Verify their identity with /verify.
relayKeyChanged: ⚠️ This relay's security key has changed — relay communication is paused. Verify the relay fingerprint with the operator before trusting it again.
relayPinned: Relay identity pinned — fingerprint {0}. Compare it with the fingerprint your relay operator published.
helpSetAddRelay: Adds another home relay after showing its fingerprint for confirmation. Extra home relays can improve availability, but each one can see metadata such as when and how much encrypted traffic passes through it.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Removes one added home relay from this device's list. The relay keeps ciphertext it already received until normal expiry; removal only stops future copies from using that relay.
relayAddPrompt: Релай URL за добавяне като дом реле
relayAddConfirm: Add {0} as a home relay? Fingerprint: {1} — add it only if this matches the fingerprint the relay operator published.
relayAddInvalid: Това не е валиден реле URL.
relayAddSelf: That URL is this relay itself — it is already your home relay.
relayAddDuplicate: Това реле вече е в дома ти релеи.
relayAddKeyless: That relay has no identity key, so it cannot be pinned — it cannot be added as a home relay.
relayAddUnreachable: That relay could not be verified — check the URL and try again.
relayAddTimeout: That server took too long to answer — wait a moment and try again. If it keeps happening, check that the server is running and not overloaded.
relayAddNotBreeze: That address answered, but it does not look like a Breeze server — make sure the URL points to your Breeze server, not to a website or another app, then try again.
relayRemoveConfirm: Remove {0} from your home relays? The relay keeps the data it already holds; it just stops receiving new copies.
helpSetFanout: For contacts that use multiple home relays, sends each message copy to this many of those relays. More copies can improve delivery if one relay is down, but they use more network traffic and store ciphertext in more places.
helpSetPowerMode: Controls how much Breeze reduces background checking to save battery. Sending is not delayed, but Saver and Emergency can make incoming messages and presence updates arrive later; Auto follows your battery when the browser reports it.
contactHomePrompt: Връзката на този контакт е в домашния реле-URL (безочистката го изчиства)
contactHomeConfirm: Set {0}'s home relay to {1}? Fingerprint: {2} — set it only if this matches the fingerprint the relay operator published.
contactHomeClearConfirm: Clear the home relay stored for {0}? Their messages will be delivered via this relay only.
p2pOnlyMode: P2P-only mode: server unreachable. Direct connections still work.
storageWarning: Storage {0}% full. Old messages may be auto-deleted.
dkOffer: On this secondary: copy this entire offer directly to your primary and run /link <offer> there. Keep both devices in your control.
dkReturn: On the same secondary, run /linkto <certificate> with this entire certificate transferred directly from this primary. Capable peers authenticate device revocations and signed group messages.
dkTrust: Trust the root signing key transferred directly from primary {0}…? Never use a certificate supplied by a relay or stranger.
dkLinked: Device encryption and signing keys bound; root signing pin authenticated
dkInvalid: Device-key proof is invalid, mismatched, stale or could not be saved
dkRemoved: Device removed from signed registry — check revocation status below
dkRevoked: Device keys revoked — future messages and group keys rejected by capable peers
dkCheckpoint: Newer signed device checkpoint detected — device traffic paused; reconnect through an independent trusted path
devLinkHint: Show this code to your PRIMARY device: there, run /link and scan it (or paste this key via /link <key>). Then back here, run /linkto and scan the primary's code (or paste its key). For authenticated key binding, run /link keys on the secondary first.
devLinkToHint: Scan the code shown by /link on your PRIMARY device (or paste its key with /linkto <key>). The primary must have added this device first.
histSendAsk: Send your conversation history to the new device? It travels encrypted, device to device — the relay never sees it.
histSent: Историята е изпратена на друг устройство
histNoDevices: Още няма свързани устройства — свържете едно с /връзка първо
histReceived: История получи: {0} съобщения от друг устройство
devLinkConfirm: Add device {0} to your account? It will receive copies of your new messages.
devAdded: Устройство добавено — тя сега трябва да извърши /linkto с ключа си
devSelfLink: Това е собственият ключ на устройството.
devBadPub: Не е валиден ключ за устройство
devBadIndex: Невалиден номер на устройството (не може да изтрие първоначалното)
devPrimaryOnly: Само първоначалното устройство може да управлява списъка с устройства
devNotListed: This device is not on that account's list yet — run /link <this device's key> on the primary first
devSetFail: Неуспешно актуализирането на списъка с устройства
toastMsgsDropped: {0} message(s) may have been lost while you were offline (relay queue overflowed)
toastOutboxExpired: {0} queued message(s) were discarded undelivered (waiting over 7 days)
toastIdentityClone: This identity is ALSO active on another device. Using both will corrupt your conversations — retire one, or link devices with /link instead.
helpSetRrDelay: Waits about two minutes, with a little random variation, before sending a read receipt. This makes your exact reading time less precise, but senders still eventually learn that the message was read.
helpSetFocus: Turns on Focus mode for one hour. Most message alerts are silenced while it is on; VIP contacts and mentions can still alert you unless strict mode is on.
helpSetFocusStrict: Removes the VIP and mention exceptions in Focus mode, so message alerts stay quiet for everyone. Incoming-call ring sounds are suppressed too, although your system may still show a visual notification.
helpSetRestoreFile: Restores an encrypted backup from a file you previously saved. You need the backup passphrase, and the restored data replaces what is on this device.
devUnlinkConfirm: Изтриване на устройството {0} от вашия смет?
groupNoVoice: Гласови съобщения още не могат да бъдат изпратени в групни разговори
groupFileTooLarge: Това файл е твърде голям за групен разговор (ограничение около 50 KB)
nrnAria: Означи това съобщение като нужда от отговор
nrnOn: Следващо съобщение: няма нужда от отговор
focusOn: Focus mode on for {0} min — VIPs and mentions still get through
focusOnStrict: Режимът на фокус за {0} мин — всичко измълчава
focusIdle: Режимът на фокусът е изключен. Използвайте/фокус 60 за час на тихо.
focusBarStrict: 🌙 Фокус, всички млъкнани — {0} мин наляво (тап до края)
vipSet: {0} ще ви достигне по време на фокусен режим
devUnlinkedNotice: This device was removed from the account — it no longer receives the account's messages. It now works as a standalone identity.
toastAliasTampered: Blocked: this handle’s key history has been tampered with. Ask the person for their public key directly.
toastAliasRolled: Warning: this handle’s key changed recently. Verify the safety number before trusting it.
identityBindingFailed: Blocked: the contact identity keys do not match. Verify the contact and try again.
confirmReport: Report this message to the operator? The message text and a one-time proof are sent so it can be verified. Other messages stay private.
toastBlockedFile: Този тип файл е блокиран за сигурността
toastFileNeedP2P: Large files require a direct P2P connection. Wait for the contact to come online.
clockDrift: Your device clock appears to be off. Messages may fail anti-replay checks.
toastDeliveryFailed: Message delivery failed after 3 attempts. Use /retry to resend.
retryDLQEmpty: Няма неуспешни съобщения, за да се опитват.
sendFailed: Изпращане неуспешно. Натиснете се за да се попробвате.
blockedFileType: Този тип файл е блокиран (изпълняващо открито)
addMembersPrompt: Добавяне на членове (комма разделени #, или празен за връзка за покани):
shareInvite: Споделяте тази връзка за поканене на членове:
invitedBy: {0} Ви покани. Внесете името си да се присъедините. (членове на {1})
toastInstallManual: To install Breeze, open your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
toastDbConflict: Конфликт на версията на базата на базата. Моля, презареждайте.
toastModulesFailed: Някои характеристики не са зареждани. Моля, презареждайте.
toastQuotaExceeded: This relay's free quota is used up. Messages stay on this device and will send when the quota resets — or add your own relay in Settings → Home relays.
toastDbBlocked: Обновяване на базата на базата е блокирана. Затворете други ливчета Breeze и презареждане.
toastLockSet: Заключване на парола. Тип /lock за активиране.

simpleDesc: Your encrypted backup will be stored on a relay you run or contract — this is never offered on the default relay. On a new device, your account name + passphrase bring the whole account back, with no phrase to write down. It is weaker than the recovery phrase: whoever runs that relay holds the ciphertext and can see that this account has a backup and when it changes, and a guessed passphrase opens it. The relay can never read it — only the passphrase can. Choose a long one.
simpleNewDesc: Pick a recovery account name — like an email address, and you must remember it exactly — and a recovery passphrase of at least 8 characters. Together they fetch and open your backup on a new device. Neither is sent to the relay; only what they unlock is.
simpleSaved: Забелязах името и фразата на сметка.
simpleAccountMin: Recovery account name must be at least 3 characters (letters, numbers, _ or -).

simpleEnrolled: Simple recovery is on. Your encrypted backup is stored on your relay.

simpleNotFound: No backup found for that account name and passphrase. Check both exactly and try again.

simpleRestoreDesc: Enter the recovery account name and passphrase you chose. The backup is fetched from this relay and opened on this device only.
simplePassChangeDesc: This passphrase names a different backup slot than the one your current backup sits in. The old backup stays under the old passphrase until it expires (90 days); restoring will need the NEW passphrase. Continue only if this change was deliberate.

secAtRestWrapOff: At-rest key encryption: ✗ OFF (identity keys as plaintext JWK — enable via /keywrap)
keywrapSuggestion: Your ID is stored on this device without a password. Set a passphrase so only you can open it.
secGroupFSOn: Group forward secrecy: ✓ ON (hash ratchet + epoch revocation)
secGroupFSOff: Group forward secrecy: ✗ OFF (static sender key; 1:1 chats keep full FS)
secCallSignalOff: Call signaling E2E: ✗ OFF (SDP relayed in plaintext)
secRecoveryNone: NONE — this identity can never be recovered
secRecoverySimple: simple recovery (account + passphrase, your own relay)
secSkippedKeys: Skipped Keys: ✓ Out-of-order message recovery (max 100 keys/session)
secDiagMsgStore: Message-store key failures / plaintext saves / open failures
secDiagLifecycle: Data-lifecycle outages (retention / remote wipe / cleanup skipped)
secDiagSealed: Sealed-queue write races the relay repaired (nothing lost)
secIceCandFilter: ICE Candidate Filter: ✓ (host IP addresses stripped)
secRelayDisabled: ✗ Off (direct P2P, IP visible to peers)
secLanDirectNote: No automatic LAN discovery on the web; for guaranteed direct LAN connection, use manual exchange (/rendezvous).
secTurnUsage: TURN share of call traffic this month
toastTurnQuota: This relay's monthly TURN budget is used up — calls try direct connections only for now. Add your own TURN in Settings to restore relayed calls.
secBruteForce: Brute force: Exponential backoff after 5 attempts
secMemoryZero: Memory zeroing: ✓ Best-effort TypedArray.fill(0) after crypto ops
secPledgeNoAds: Ads: none. Tracking: none. Analytics: none.
secPledgeE2ee: Message content: end-to-end encrypted — the relay only holds sealed envelopes it cannot read
secSealedSenderNote: Sealed sender: the relay cannot see who sent a message — but that is not unlinkability. Timing and network metadata can still link activity.
secPledgeRetention: Relay storage is temporary: undelivered envelopes ≤ 7 days, aliases ≤ 90 days, all auto-expiring. Relay backup storage: OFF unless its operator enables it

migrateHtml:
Migrate from LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Step 1: Invite contacts (1-on-1)
Type /invite to copy an invite message → paste in LINE/WhatsApp
Type /qr to show a QR code → let them scan it
Step 1b: Move a whole group
Type /newgroup Your Group Name → generates an invite link
→ Paste the link in your LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Members just open the link to join automatically
Step 2: Import chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → save .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
Type /import and select the file, or drag-drop onto the chat area
Step 3: Set up notifications
Allow browser notifications to get alerts for new messages
Add to Home Screen for an app-like experience

cfNote: The token is stored only on this device. Browser requests pass statelessly through this origin's /api/cf-proxy to Cloudflare's API without being logged or stored. Verified relays with a relay key are added to Home Relays automatically.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Stores the Cloudflare API token only in this device's IndexedDB settings store. It is sent only to Cloudflare's API as a Bearer token, never to Breeze relays. Server setup needs a token with account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit permissions.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Calls Cloudflare's token verification and account list APIs with the token saved on this device, then shows the real token status and account names or the actual error. The token is sent only to Cloudflare's API. Server setup needs account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit permissions.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Deletes the saved Cloudflare API token from this device's IndexedDB settings store and clears the shown connection state. It does not revoke the token, and it does not delete the Worker, KV namespace, or any other resource from your Cloudflare account.
helpSetCloudflareSetup: Creates or reuses the breeze-presence KV namespace, uploads the bundled Breeze Worker as the breeze script with the required KV binding, enables its workers.dev address, and checks /api/health. The token needs account read (list accounts), Workers Scripts edit, and Workers KV Storage edit. The server URL is stored on this device only; add it as a home relay from Relays if you want to use it. Setup does not configure optional secrets for push notifications, TURN, or the relay identity key, so those features stay off or in their default fallback until configured in the Cloudflare dashboard.
cfSetupToggle: Настройване на собствения си сървър на Cloudflare
cfGuideText: Create an API token with Account Settings: Read, Workers Scripts: Edit, and Workers KV Storage: Edit, then paste it below.
helpSetCloudflareQuick: Saves the pasted Cloudflare API token on this device, verifies the account, creates the KV namespace and workers.dev subdomain if needed, deploys the Breeze Worker, and checks /api/health in one step.
